title: Unlocking opportunities: A family’s guide to college financial aid and scholarships
summary_en: Financial aid can be confusing. Here's a guide covering the options available and how to get them to help you and your college-bound teen.
title_cn: Unlocking opportunities: A family’s guide to college financial aid and scholarships

title: All hands on deck: UNI nursing students join area responders for simulated emergency
summary_en: At UNI, nursing students are gaining hands-on experience in emergency preparedness right on campus. A simulated mass casualty incident tested how students and area responders can come together when a large disaster occurs with limited resources.
title_cn: All hands on deck: UNI nursing students join area responders for simulated emergency
